task.population: The phlebotomy-weighted complete-measurement domain of nonpregnant women aged 20–44 in NHANES August 2021–August 2023; RIDEXPRG=2, both measured hemoglobin and raw ferritin, positive phlebotomy weight. Pregnancy unknown/incomplete excluded; no CRP restriction. Equal-weight virtual rows represent this domain only under explicit transport assumptions. No individual measurements or target outcome summaries are supplied.

excluded_cohorts: National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey

model.scenario_label: Assumption-driven working population; not calibrated to target outcomes
model.law: Two-component Gaussian Hb/log-ferritin model, conditioned within each component on bounded Hb
